verdict.rationale: Carta documents a REST API with the OAuth 2.0 CLIENT_CREDENTIALS grant, which gives machine-to-machine access to company data without a user's interactive consent. Service-account apps for the Investor API and a playground environment returning static valid responses also support unattended, scriptable automation. However, there is no documented CLI, no CI-specific guidance, no OpenAPI spec (probe 404), and most endpoints are v1alpha1. Missing for 10: official CLI or headless tool, CI/CD integration docs, published OpenAPI spec, non-alpha API stability, independent hands-on corroboration of automated use.
